title: Law Library
purpose: Legal-knowledge surfaces; authority and precedent messaging.
story: A law library walled floor to ceiling in bound volumes — the accumulated weight of precedent, kept in ordered silence.
environment: A narrow library room, matching bound volumes filling every wall to the ceiling, a reading table at the centre.
architecture: Panelled chambers interior — fitted bookcases to the cornice, a small gallery rail, a coffered ceiling lost in shadow.
composition: Walls of uniform spines framing a central reading table, a brass lamp pooling warm light, the upper shelves dissolving into negative space.
continuityNotes: Holds the set's near-black grade, single warm source, and brass-on-black palette of scene-01; no legible titles on any volume.
